name: China Bowl
why_it_matters: Pachmarhi's only dedicated Indo-Chinese kitchen, at Greendale on Rajbhawan Road — the default order for families on a third-night hill-station break when the kids want noodles instead of more dal-roti. Tripadvisor-listed; Justdial-listed as Pachmarhi Chinese. The format is small-town Indo-Chinese, not Hakka-purist.
insider_tip: Skip the seafood section — Pachmarhi is 600km from the nearest coast, the seafood is frozen and aged. Stick to the paneer-and-noodles core. Cash plus UPI. Open lunch and dinner; closed during the off-season monsoon weeks Jul-Aug (Pachmarhi virtually shuts).
signature_address: Greendale, Rajbhawan Road, Jaistambh Chowk, Pachmarhi, Madhya Pradesh 461881

name: MPT Glenview Restaurant
area: Inside MPT Glenview, near the Pachmarhi reservoir
why_it_matters: MPT Glenview is a heritage-styled bungalow with 25 AC rooms, set near the Pachmarhi reservoir — its restaurant is one of the few full-format sit-down options in Pachmarhi with a stocked bar. The British-era cantonment architecture is the unsung pull; the restaurant has wood-panelled dining and serves the same Indian-continental menu MPT does cleanly elsewhere.
insider_tip: Glenview is on the higher-end of MPT's Pachmarhi portfolio (alongside Champak Bungalow and Satpura Retreat); the bar is worth a drink even if dinner is elsewhere. Reserve Oct-Feb weekends. The kitchen's strongest food is the tandoor section — order from there.
signature_address: MPT Glenview, Near Pachmarhi Reservoir, Pachmarhi, Madhya Pradesh 461881

name: MPT Champak Bungalow Restaurant
area: Inside MPT Champak Bungalow, Central Pachmarhi
why_it_matters: MPT Champak Bungalow's in-house restaurant — the more centrally-located alternative to Glenview if your base is in Pachmarhi town proper rather than on the cantonment-reservoir side. The 'Champak' theme is a British-cantonment-bungalow restoration similar to Glenview; the food side is identical MPT-standard.
insider_tip: Use Champak if your accommodation is also there; for non-resident diners, Glenview has a better bar but Champak has a quieter restaurant. Off-season monsoon (Jul-Aug) the menu shrinks — call ahead. Mid-range price point, not destination food.
signature_address: MPT Champak Bungalow, Central Pachmarhi, Madhya Pradesh 461881

name: Rasoi Dhawa
signature_dish: Tandoori chicken + Mughlai non-veg in the cantonment
why_it_matters: Open-air restaurant near Company Garden — one of the very few non-veg sit-down options in mostly-vegetarian Pachmarhi, which is why it gets disproportionately crowded. Tripadvisor 3.4/5 — reviews flag it as 'crowded because it's the only one cooking decent non-veg, not because it's the best'. Honest framing, not breathless praise.
insider_tip: Service is slow when busy — that's the trade-off for being the only non-veg option. Lunch is faster than dinner. Skip rainy days (open-air section gets wet). Cash plus UPI. Pricing is 30-40% higher than veg-only Pachmarhi places — fair if you're set on tandoor that night.
signature_address: Patel Marg, Near Company Garden, Cantonment, Pachmarhi, Madhya Pradesh 461881
